task.title: A partial extra_binaries in urunc cofniguration loses its default values
task.body:
When a config file defines an `[extra_binaries.*]` section but omits some of its fields, the omitted fields are left empty instead of falling back to urunc's
built-in defaults.

For example in virtiofsd if we only set the path:

```toml
[extra_binaries.virtiofsd]
path = "/opt/urunc/bin/virtiofsd"
```

then the options will stay blank.

This was found during the review of https://github.com/urunc-dev/urunc/pull/982
